name: Teito Gensou
source:
Main character decides to investigate rumors about strange sounds at school at night. As a result he  teleports to a different world and gets involved in a conflict between the imperial army and the resistance.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角決定調查學校夜裡傳出怪聲的傳聞，結果被傳送到另一個世界，並捲入了帝國軍與反抗軍之間的衝突。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
